contracts.description: Material changes preserve an identifiable previous state and restoration path.
Critical external effects require scoped authority bound to the action and revision.
Applicable quality attributes are measurable scenarios with fresh evidence.
Environments isolate exposure, data, credentials and cost controls.
Paid services have measurement, budgets, alerts, quotas and application containment.
Material runs declare model routing and compute ceilings; unavailable usage is never zero.
Persistent services have approved RTO/RPO and fresh restore evidence.
RTO/RPO evolution uses the maximum exposure ratio across people, operations, economic value and data while preserving safety floors.
